mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate (a CNS depressant) and rasagiline is a non-selective MAO inhibitor; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome and excessive CNS depression.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia) and CNS depression; consider alternative muscle relaxants.
